title: Houston Rockets jersey history No. 35 - Lonny Baxter (2005-06)
text:
Rockets jersey history No. 35 - Lonny Baxter (2005-06) Rumors Stats Odds Betting Newsletter ROCKETS Houston Rockets jersey history No. 35 - Lonny Baxter (2005-06)
 Justin Quinn Rockets Wire Oct. 29, 2026, 9:00 p.m. CT The  Houston Rockets  have had players donning a total of 52 different jersey numbers (and have one not part of any numerical series for Houston assistant coach and general manager Carroll Dawson) since their founding at the start of the 1967-68 season, worn by just under 500 players in the course of Rockets history.
 To honor all of the players who wore those numbers over the decades, Rockets Wire is covering the entire history of jersey numbers and the players who wore them since the founding of the team all those years ago right up to the present day.
 With seven of those jerseys now retired to honor some of the greatest Rockets of all time to wear those jerseys, there is a lot of history to cover.
 And for today's article, we will continue with the eighth of 11 who wore the No. 35, Lonny Baxter. After ending his college career at Maryland, Baxter was picked up with the 44th overall selection of the 2002 NBA Draft by the Chicago Bulls.
 The Silver Spring, Maryland native played the first 2 seasons of his pro career with Chicago. He also played for the Toronto Raptors , Washington Wizards , and (then) New Orleans Hornets (now, Pelicans) before he signed with the Houston Rockets in 2005. His stay with the team lasted until he was dealt to the Charlotte Bobcats in 2006.
 Love crosswords? Explore the Crossword page and play the new MidGrid Crossword. During his time suiting up for the Rockets, Baxter wore only jersey No. 35 and put up 3.6 points and 3.7 rebounds per game.
